caseName: City of New York v. Brooklyn Union Gas Co.
caseNameFull: City of New York v. Brooklyn Union Gas Company
summary: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the Southern District, of New York:

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the *684authority of the City of New York v. Consolidated Gas Co., 253 U. S. 219. Mr. Vincent Victory, with whom Mr. James A. Donnelly and Mr. Henry Hertzoff were on the brief, for appellant. Mr. William N. Dykman, for appellee, submitted.
